audit_kind: Read-only final source and historical-content integrity audit

scope.selected_sources: Every one of selected-repair.json files is hashed against both current worktree skills and the physical repaired/skills snapshot; exact file-set equality excludes bytecode caches.
scope.application_verification: Read existing final159 receipt and text log only; compare receipt package hashes with selected/current sources; do not execute tests.
scope.knowledge_verification: Read existing60-test plain-text success log and supplemental structured knowledge-checks.json only; statically count current test methods; compare all23 knowledge package files with pre-change, selected-repair and structured-receipt source hashes. Root re-executed the same60 checks; no tests were rerun by this reviewer and no distinct-test count was added.
scope.historical_comparison: Compare only pre-change.original_files entries with corresponding worktree regular files in original v1, September and October18 releases, pre-current-cycle review evidence, immutable gold and historical references. Groups overlap; unique checked paths=3398. Historical run/capture/possible-answer artifacts are included by SHA256 only after explicit clarification; their contents are neither parsed nor output.
scope.no_original_directory_comparison: Original checkout has not been synchronized; absence of current-cycle reports there is intentionally not tested or treated as failure.
scope.prohibited_reads: No current reviews/2026-10-19-workplace runs/, app-grades/, captures/ or answers were read. The supplemental893 historical paths are all outside the current cycle and were read solely as opaque byte streams to compare SHA256.

knowledge.limitation: The plain text knowledge log contains no invocation, timestamp, explicit process-exit record or source hashes. Its recorded60/OK is verified, but no independent rerun or cryptographic binding of that execution to a particular source snapshot is claimed.

supplemental_structured_receipt.reason: Final evidence binding: prior plain-text success log lacked command/source fingerprints. Same60 checks re-executed with structured receipt, not counted as additional distinct tests.

limitation_resolution.evidence: Structured root receipt records UTC timestamp, exact argv, per-command returncode and successful unittest counts, 23 source hashes, and byte stability during execution. Independent audit rehashed the current23 and matched the selected repair hashes.
limitation_resolution.remaining_limit: This reviewer did not rerun tests or observe root execution live; this remains a local receipt and source-hash audit, not external attestation.
